pages.notes: Declassified government document with embedded classification markers and redactions; OCR captured most visible text but contains errors including 'EXPLBITED' (should be 'EXPLOITED'), '7•LINED' (should be '7-LINED'), and line-wrapping inconsistencies in the narrative section.

Military intelligence form with official redactions. Header has significant OCR errors (e.g., 'D cl d by' for 'Declassified by', 'Jaruary' for 'January'); form structure and field names mostly captured correctly, but redacted field markers produce OCR artifacts; footer information legible.

Form with personnel and equipment fields captures well overall, but OCR degraded the faded declassification header (misread 'Richard A. Harrison' as 'chard A Hamson', 'Chief' as 'Ct11ef'); redaction boxes and formatting of classification codes show minor errors.
Declassified government form with aircraft mission timeline; OCR captured most text accurately but mishandled some redacted field indicators and misread 'AH/GMESH' as 'AWGMESH'.

Declassified intelligence form with structured fields and narrative sections. OCR struggles with the pink declassification header (reads 'V.G R1cnard A. 1-'amso~' instead of 'MG Richard A. Harrison') and misinterprets redaction boxes as text characters; main document body is mostly accurate.

Structured military form with multiple redacted fields (marked with classification codes like 1.4a, 1.4g); OCR captures the form structure and most readable text accurately, but represents some redaction boxes inconsistently (showing ~ and | characters instead of box notations) and misreads the Friendly Aircraft Location field where multiple redactions overlap.

Form content clearly captured, but OCR struggled with redacted coordinate sections (reading tildes and nonsense characters instead of blanked areas) and misread 'Harrison' as 'He:iison'. Red redaction bars and classification stamps interfered with some text recognition.
